notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to produce at least {3}{U} between Tolarian Academy and up to one additional land.
description:
Activate Tolarian Academy and up to other land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Tolarian Academy and up to one other land.
Activate Tolarian Academy and up to one other land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.
